step_1_role_verification.protocol_requirement: Verify the requesting agent's role before executing cross-role operation
step_1_role_verification.expected_behavior: System should verify agent-b's assigned role (resource-inspector) and detect that it lacks authority to claim security-auditor
step_1_role_verification.actual_behavior: System checks that delegation chain records have non-empty fields (delegator, acting_as, signature). All 3 records pass because all fields are non-empty strings. No cryptographic verification of signatures is performed.
step_1_role_verification.root_cause: VULN-DELEG-001: No cryptographic signature infrastructure exists. The system uses field-existence validation (if field != '') as a proxy for signature verification. Any string satisfies this check.
step_1_role_verification.bypass_technique: Forged plaintext signature strings (SIG-LEAD-AGENT-FORGED-*, SIG-RESOURCE-INSPECTOR-FORGED-*, SIG-AGENT-B-SELF-ESCALATION-*) pass the non-empty field check. Chain of trust is based on string concatenation, not cryptographic chains.

step_2_scope_check.protocol_requirement: Check that the cross-role operation is within the requesting agent's scope
step_2_scope_check.expected_behavior: Security-auditor operations (read_all, write_audit_log, can_delegate, can_spawn_workers) should be rejected because agent-b's assigned role (resource-inspector) is limited to read_metrics and report_anomalies
step_2_scope_check.actual_behavior: Scope verification function reads the 'acting_as' field from the delegation record (value: 'security-auditor') and checks operations against the security-auditor scope. The assigned role 'resource-inspector' is never referenced in the scope check. Operations pass because 'acting_as=security-auditor' includes all requested scopes.
step_2_scope_check.root_cause: VULN-DELEG-002: Scope verification uses self-reported acting_as field instead of the immutable assigned_role from the role assignment table. The agent controls its own scope boundary through a simple string field.
step_2_scope_check.bypass_technique: Set acting_as=security-auditor in the final delegation record (Level 2). The scope check evaluates: 'Does security-auditor scope include read_all, write_audit_log, etc.?' Answer: Yes. It never asks: 'Is agent-b actually a security-auditor?'

step_3_audit_log.protocol_requirement: Log the cross-role access for audit purposes
step_3_audit_log.expected_behavior: Unauthorized role escalation from resource-inspector to security-auditor should trigger WARN or ALERT level audit entries. Security system should detect the anomalous permission elevation and generate an intrusion alert.
step_3_audit_log.actual_behavior: Audit log entries for this escalation were written by agent-b itself (now holding forged security-auditor role with write_audit_log permission). Escalation events were logged with fabricated 'authorized' tags. No alert was generated because: (a) the audit writer (agent-b) controls the log content, (b) no external monitoring system correlates audit events with expected role transitions, (c) the audit log format (JSONL) has no integrity protection.
step_3_audit_log.root_cause: VULN-DELEG-003: Audit logs are appendable and modifiable by any agent holding write_audit_log permission. Once the attacker escalates to security-auditor (which includes write_audit_log), they control their own audit trail.
step_3_audit_log.bypass_technique: Write audit entries with severity=INFO and classification=authorized_role_delegation to the audit log, replacing any WARN/ALERT entries that the system might have auto-generated during the escalation attempt. The resulting audit trail shows a normal, authorized role transition rather than an intrusion.

cumulative_result.conclusion: All three layers of cross-role verification are bypassed. The security model's defense-in-depth collapses because each layer depends on the integrity of lower layers that have already been compromised: Step 1 (Role Verification) depends on cryptographic verification that doesn't exist → Step 2 (Scope Check) depends on role verification that was already bypassed → Step 3 (Audit Log) depends on scope enforcement that was already bypassed.
